description: This source file implements drain file management functions for a loader application, including creating, ranking, checking, and cleaning up drain files based on expiration and application keys.

methods.name: ExtractAppKey
methods.description: Extracts the application key from a drain file name string.

methods.name: ExtractTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts the timestamp from a drain file name string and converts it to microseconds.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Determines if a drain file is expired based on its timestamp.

methods.name: FindAllWithPrefix
methods.description: Finds all filenames in a directory that start with a given prefix.

methods.name: Rank
methods.description: Ranks drain files in a directory by timestamp and app key, returning the app key of the most recent file.

methods.name: TryDrain
methods.description: Checks for existing valid drain files for an app; creates one if none exist.

methods.name: RankAndCheck
methods.description: Ranks drain files and checks if the top-ranked file matches the given app key.

methods.name: ClearExpired
methods.description: Removes expired drain files from a directory.

methods.name: ClearForApp
methods.description: Removes all drain files for a specific app.

methods.name: PrepareDirectory
methods.description: Prepares a directory by removing unrelated drain files.

methods.name: IsAppDraining
methods.description: Checks if an app is currently draining based on existing drain files.

methods.name: IsAnotherAppDraining
methods.description: Checks if any other app is draining in the directory.
